{{Short description|Football results}}
The '''2023 Copa Sudamericana group stage''' was played from 4 April to 29 June 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://d2soj90bepqxla.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Calendario-2023_aprobado-Consejo-07-julio-2022.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2023: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=7 July 2022|access-date=7 July 2022}}</ref><ref name="fixture">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Fixture-Sudamericana_Fase-de-Grupos-CS-2023.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2023 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - FASE DE GRUPOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión 28/03/2023|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=28 March 2023|access-date=28 March 2023}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide 16 of the 24 places in the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]] of the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CS-2023-1.pdf|title=CONMEBOL Sudamericana / Manual de Clubes 2023|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|access-date=9 March 2023}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the group stage was held on 27 March 2023, 20:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/sistema-de-sorteo-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana/|title=Sistema de sorteo de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana|trans-title=CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana draw system|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=20 March 2023|access-date=22 March 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/los-grupos-para-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2023/|title=Los Grupos para la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2023|trans-title=The Groups for the 2023 CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=27 March 2023|access-date=28 March 2023}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 9 December 2022 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://conmebollibertadores.com/cards/NewsReaderWeb/ranking-de-clubes-conmebol-2023|title=Ranking de Clubes CONMEBOL 2023|publisher=CONMEBOL Libertadores|date=16 December 2022|access-date=17 December 2022|language=es}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=2 February 2021|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830090237/https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|archive-date=30 August 2021}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2013–2022.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2012 and 2002–2012 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.

For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. The four losers of the [[2023 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Third stage|Copa Libertadores third stage]] were seeded into Pot 4. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the group stage, each group is played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The teams are ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Away goals scored; 5. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 2.4.2).<ref name="regulations"/>

The winners of each group advanced to the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]], whilst the runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Knockout round play-offs|knockout round play-offs]] of the final stages.<section end=Format />
